full_judgment: 3. It was the case of the defendants in the two suits that the alleged Hibe-bil-Ewaj was without any consideration, it was not acted upon and in 1930 their father Oliullah was a mere tenant-at-will under the Baliadi Zaminders and had no transferable interest in the suit land. Their father took Mirashi Pattan from the Zaminder in February 1944 and they inherited the same and are in joint possession of the land covered by the Hiba deed. They are not licensees under the plaintiff.
